profile.headline: Senior Consultant Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I have a wide range of experience spanning startups to multi-nationals such as Amazon and Visa.  My objective now is to bring my wealth of engineering experience to bear on solving problems in an elegant, efficient, scalable, and reliable manner.   While my most recent work has been in the financial payments industry, I have worked across many other industries including electrical power control room software, commercial printing software (imposition), on-line retail site backend support and medical device development.

I specialize in RESTful web service architecture and databases hosted in on-site and cloud environments.  Design of scalable, 24/7 service-side applications using C# and Java deployed to either containers or virtual machines. .  

Accomplishments include
 * Implementation and management of Payment decryption at scale including requisite encryption key management
 * Implementation and support of OAuth 2.0 tokenization support for the authentication token workflow at scale.
 * Implementation of platform-critical custom network traffic routing at scale for active-active support for multi-tenant web service APIs.
 * Design and implementation of end-to-end  API message level encryption which supports not only efficiency of operation but simplicity of adoption for existing API users.
 * Design and implementation of web hook infrastructure which is scalable and loosely coupled (message based) for guaranteed deliveries.
 * Design of relational databases from scratch 
 * Design of a logging system which enabled efficient and simultaneous presentation of log entries in multiple languages.

Familiar with  T-SQL, JQuery, Powershell, Claude Code

Also familiar with NHIbernate (fluent and non-fluent) database style and Github source repositories.

Certified Scrum Master since 2005.

Concerning client/server software and web services, I am comfortable in C# and Java 17
Recent development experience with  
a) Rapid development using both ChatGPT and Claude Code
b) High-volume 24/7 operations responsible for mission-critical element support and development
c) Cryptographic support for both symmetric and asymmetric (RSA) encryption

positions.description: Working on payment portals for use by the whole spectrum of merchants from mom & pop online stores to enterprise-sized merchants.  All while providing significant value-added features, first-class security and rock solid reliability.

positions.description: We're in the business of connecting content with browsers.  Heavily using cloud-based web services leveraging AWS EC2 deployments and Docker container deployments.  Experienced also in Microsoft Workflow Framework, IIS/.NET services as well as Tomcat/Docker container web services.

positions.description: Worked on Demand Response curtailment systems for the coordination of smart grid technologies (remotely readable meters, program-controlled thermostats, etc.).in the electrical distribution industry. Left due to company restructuring.

positions.description: Duties concentrated on server-side support for a medical system which facilitated the accurate measurement of the volume of the right ventricle of the heart using sonograms and a UW-proprietary knowledge-based post-processing technology.

positions.description: Work with implementation of IPTV software for home entertainment via the internet to your television.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Senior software engineer in the retail system section of Amazon, the position involves improving the business-to-business relationships with Amazon vendors by creating systems which empower those vendors to manage many aspects of the relationship themselves.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on Preps, the world's leading printing imposition software tool.  Was the principal Windows developer for that product but also was involved in some OS X (Panther) development as the tool was hosted on both platforms.   
Supported a significant in-house PDF generation module written in C++.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Duties included design and implementation of PC-based software products for the electronics manufacturing industry.  Development environment utilizes the Microsoft Visual Studio integrated development environment and the Microsoft Foundation Class framework.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsibilities included design, development, and integration of command and control system for elect power utilities involving both in-house and on-site tasks. Among projects undertaken was an in-house language for internationalized string and message definitions. The company is now doing business as Areva-T&D.
